name: hud_sensor_tracker_zar_mission_save_callback
description: HudSensorTracker::ZarMission_SaveCallback forwards the ZAR Mission writer callback to WriteMissionDataSection and returns the write status. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly at 0x417680 shows the fastcall callback pushing the writer argument, moving the self argument into ecx, calling HudSensorTracker::WriteMissionDataSection, and returning that callee result.
HudSensorTracker::WriteMissionDataSection is dependency-ready and functional-equivalent for this use.

The native callback smoke invokes ZarMission_SaveCallback through a real zZbdManager section callback, verifies the callback return value, section path, payload size, and representative serialized MissionData fields.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x417680 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
